# skyhub_dhcp_reservation (Resource)

A DHCP address reservation (LAN IP Setup > Address Reservation). Takes effect at the device's next lease renewal; the hub is never rebooted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skyhub_dhcp_reservation" "nas" {
  mac  = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"
  ip   = "192.168.50.20"
  name = "nas"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Reserved IPv4 address.
- `mac` (String) Client MAC address, e.g. `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff`. Changing it replaces the reservation.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Device label shown in the hub UI (up to 17 characters).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The MAC address (lower-case, colon separated).
- `index` (Number) 1-based row index on the hub (informational).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skyhub_dhcp_reservation.nas aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff
```
